notes: All completed runs retained, including safe stops and HTTP/video errors.
exploratory_shared_host overlapped the Python suite for approximately its first minute; not a controlled comparison.
intermediate_parallel_after used independent point/mesh HTTP pulls each second; final uses one active map transfer and two seconds between starts.
The intermediate held-path failure predates final stationary pacing but already pauses map while held; later motion passes cannot be attributed to stationary pacing.
Early reports do not include backend failure-context fields added for final trials; invalidations identify observed latch causes.
Empty early error strings represent exceptions rendered without their type; later reports prefix the exception type.
proxy_stats counts span startup and measurement; proxy_kbps uses measurement bytes only.
Commands/status cadences and acknowledgement samples may include warmup; stream byte rates are reset after warmup.
No real packet loss, decoded display, live phone/Tailscale/Jetson or physical motors qualified.
